title: OCT-FedSIR: Toward Trustworthy Federated Ophthalmic Learning under Annotation Noise
abstract: arXiv:2609.14734v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Federated learning enables collaborative model development without centralizing patient data, but annotation reliability at participating institutions cannot always be assumed. In ophthalmic imaging, differences in disease prevalence and class composition can resemble changes caused by corrupted supervision. We introduce OCT-FedSIR, a reliability-aware spectral framework for federated OCT classification under client-dependent annotation noise and heterogeneous data distributions. OCT-FedSIR combines class-balanced spectral estimation, Stage-I logit adjustment, complementary spectral descriptors, selective spectral relabeling, and noise-aware federated optimization. We evaluated the framework on the Kermany, University of Illinois Chicago, and Wake Forest datasets under symmetric and structured asymmetric noise and three levels of non-IID heterogeneity. translated_title: OCT-FedSIR：面向标注噪声下可信联邦眼科学习的框架
translated_abstract: 联邦学习能够在无需集中患者数据的情况下实现协作式模型开发，但参与机构的标注可靠性无法始终得到保证。在眼科影像中，疾病患病率和类别构成的差异可能与损坏监督所引起的变化相似。我们提出了OCT-FedSIR，一个面向联邦OCT分类的可靠性感知谱方法框架，能够应对客户端相关的标注噪声和异构数据分布。OCT-FedSIR结合了类别平衡谱估计、第一阶段logit调整、互补谱描述子、选择性谱重标注以及噪声感知联邦优化。我们在Kermany、伊利诺伊大学芝加哥分校和维克森林数据集上，于对称与结构化非对称噪声以及三种非IID异构程度条件下对该框架进行了评估。在117个实验条件下，OCT-FedSIR实现了86.73%的平均准确率。
tldr: OCT-FedSIR提出了一种可靠性感知的谱方法框架，通过类别平衡谱估计、logit调整、选择性谱重标注和噪声感知联邦优化，在客户端标注噪声与非IID异构数据分布下实现可信的联邦OCT眼科分类。
en_tdlr: OCT-FedSIR is a reliability-aware spectral framework that combines class-balanced spectral estimation, Stage-I logit adjustment, selective spectral relabeling, and noise-aware federated optimization to enable trustworthy federated OCT classification under client-dependent annotation noise and heterogeneous non-IID data.
